mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 5.0% over the past month signals an easing monetary cycle, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 4.0% triggers a surge in labor market confidence, reducing risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained outpace of demand (GDPC1) over supply (INDPRO) by 10% signals inflationary pressures, leading to higher risk premiums and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when the demand-supply gap exceeds 10%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising) and weakening demand (GDPC1 falling) signal recessionary pressures, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during concurrent FEDFUNDS rise and GDPC1 fall.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained CPIAUCSL below 2.0% triggers reduced rate hike expectations, lowering discount rates on equities and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL stays below 2.0% in late-cycle context.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in labor participation (PAYEMS) below 120 million triggers reduced job market confidence, increasing risk aversion and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when PAYEMS drops below 120 million.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and rise in federal funds rates signals labor market strength conflicting with monetary tightening, creating market uncertainty and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during UNRATE <4% and FEDFUNDS rise.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 5.0% triggers accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates on equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS falls below 5.0%.
